comments.html:
Even if that were implemented perfectly (which would be a major change in the orchestration process and require synchronization between host and container processes), you'd still have the challenge of creating a P2P link between two containers.

Today, a P2P link is just a vEth cable between a pair of containers. With your approach, you'd need some extra glue between two tap interfaces pulled out of the container namespaces.
comments.name: Ivan Pepelnjak

comments.html: Seems all overly complicated to me. The host side of the virtual qemu interface (the tap interface) could just be moved out of the container's network namespace into the root network namespace after qemu has created the interface. No veth pairs with and tc redirect glue needed.
comments.name: Sebastian Schrader
